purpose: Canonical edge-case vectors for decisions D1-D4 of the SDK remediation. Siblings of snip00_tests.json; byte-identical across go-sharenote/testdata, sharenotejs, sharenotelib. See followup/VALIDATION-CONTRACT.md for the schema.
amount_units: Integer amounts are in the coin's base unit (its smallest unit; satoshi on Bitcoin as an example).
operand_coercion: A D1 operand is {"label": "<NNZcc>"} (continuous z-bits = z + cents*0.01) or {"z_bits": <float64>} (label floor derived from it).

cases.name: d1_same_label_diff_zbits_equal
cases.notes: Both float to label 34Z10, so they are EQUAL even though continuous z-bits differ. A by-z_bits comparator wrongly returns -1.

cases.name: d1_same_label_diff_zbits_equal_2
cases.notes: Same label 34Z10 from two different continuous values; equal. A by-z_bits comparator wrongly returns 1.

cases.name: d2_near_integer_clamps_to_99
cases.notes: z_bits is the float64 just below 34 (0x1.0ffffffffffffp+5 = nextafter(34,0)). The pricing-floor epsilon makes raw cents compute to 100, which MUST clamp to 99 -> 33Z99 (NIP-SN Discrete Denomination step 3). The buggy carry branch wrongly yields 34Z00.

cases.name: d3_fold_combined_note_exact
cases.notes: Step 0 combines to exactly 2^53+2 (=9007199254740994). Folding that result back with 1Z00 MUST yield exactly 2^53+4 (=9007199254740996). Re-deriving the folded note's difficulty from its display z-bits collapses to 2^53+2 (off by one note). The implementation MUST carry the stored exact difficulty into the next combine (A1).

cases.name: d4_invoice_amount_2pow53_plus_1
cases.notes: 2^53+1 base units must round-trip exactly; a float64/JS number parser loses the +1.

cases.name: d4_payment_amount_max_int64
cases.notes: max int64 (2^63-1); a float64 parser rounds up and overflows.

cases.name: d4_threshold_above_2pow53
cases.notes: 1e17+1 base units; a float64 parser drops the +1.
